artboards: Claude Design artboard 22, ruling B (2026-10-07), twelve equal segments in four groups of three; superseding docs/design/parts-brief-2026-09-18.md section 2.16 for the row variant
source: Claude Design artboard 22 (Divergence board 2026-10-07), ruling B, verbatim: "Twelve equal 12 px segments in four groups of three, filled left to right in the ramp colour. Replaces the stepped four-bar meter everywhere, legend included." The full variant's source is unchanged (docs/design/parts-brief-2026-09-18.md section 2.16, last paragraph).
notes: Row variant, REPLACED 2026-10-07 (lane PAR-1): the stepped four-bar fill is deleted. The row draws the TOTAL N/12 as twelve equal segments in four groups of three; segment i is filled when i < N, so the fill runs left to right. All filled segments share ONE colour read off the severity ramp at N (1 #16A34A, 4 #CA8A04, 7 #F97316, 12 #DC2626, linear interpolation), the unfilled track is #E5E1DB, and two rows with the same N render byte-identical markup (asserted at the source level by src/components/ui/ImpactMeter.npmtest.mjs and on a real render by smoke/impact-meter-partial-smoke.mjs).

GEOMETRY, one reading recorded: the ruling says '12 px segments' and the system sheet gives no gap, so a segment is 12px tall and 3px wide with a 1px gap inside a group and a 3px gap between groups, which keeps the meter plus its N/12 figure inside the list row's fixed 88px impact track. If Claude Design means 12px wide, the row grid has to widen; the lane's DESIGN CHANGES OWED entry asks.
Row-scored fixture (sum 7/12, dims cost:1 compliance:1 client:2 operational:3): segments 1 to 7 filled in rampColor(7) = #F97316, segments 8 to 12 the #E5E1DB track.

Row-partial fixture (sum 2/12, dims cost:0 compliance:0 client:0 operational:2): segments 1 and 2 filled in rampColor(2) = #529B33, segments 3 to 12 the track. The same dimension vector as before, kept because it is still the partial-fill case.
Row-unscored: the same twelve segments as 1px dashed rgba(0,0,0,.3) outlines, no fill, and an em dash in the score slot. No word.

DAUDIT-2 (2026-10-08): the score-slot rows (sum label, bold N, unscored dash, partial sum) address the `*-valued` mount cells, which pass valueVisible. The default row variant draws no visible value (ImpactMeter.tsx header, lane PAR-1b), so those rows measured a slot the default row never draws; the legend and the detail rail pass valueVisible and draw it. Values are unchanged.

Full variant track: unchanged. height:8px, border-radius:8px, background linear-gradient(90deg,#16A34A,#F97316 55%,#DC2626), label column 116px, bar column flex, value column 64px right-aligned tabular-nums 12.5px.
Full variant, unscored: unchanged, the 96px dashed baseline.
